CODE FOR INSTALLATION SPACE 

INCLUDING CONNECTIONS FOR CAR RADIO 

FOR FRONT INSTALLATION 



1. Scope 

1.1 This standard lays down dimensions of the installation space for car radio and its electrical 
connections for front installation. It also recommends a type of rear fixing, if necessary. 

1.1.1 It is applicable to the installation of a car radio whether or not combined with, for example, 
tape equipment. 

2. Dimensions of the Installation Space 

2.1 Figure 1 gives the dimensions for installation by front fixing.

3. Additional Fixing — Fixing additional to the front fixing may be provided. Wiiere rear fixing is

FIG. 3 REAR FIXING, IF NECESSARY 



4. Guidelines for Installation 

4.1 The space shall be so planned that the car radio is easily visible and within hand reach of the driver. 

4.2 It is reconnmended that the planned installation angle should not be more than 45° from the 
horizontal where the rear of the car radio slopes downward. 

4.3 In particular, ventilation of the space reserved for the car radio is recommeded. Heating of the 
car radio due to the proximity of the heating system shall be avoided. 

4.4 All holes and apertures shall be free from sharp edges to minimize the risk of injury during 
installation. 



EXPLAN ATO RY NOTE 

This standard is based on ISO 7736-1984 'Road vehicles — car radio for front installation — 
installation space including connections', issued by the International Organization for Standardization 
(ISO).
